tools.name: search_kits
tools.description: Search the Agentropolis index of 41,801 agent-usable listings (MCP servers, x402/MPP pay-per-call HTTP APIs, A2A agents and kits) by task keywords, with optional filters. Use it first when you need a tool for a task; then use get_kit for one listing's trust evidence and price, or get_kit_manifest fo

tools.name: get_kit
tools.description: Get the full Agentropolis record for one listing by id: summary, pricing, payment-verified trust evidence (verified buyers, settlements, wash flags, disclosed test sales), badge tiers, sources and links. Use it after search_kits to judge whether a listing is worth using; use get_kit_manifest instead

tools.name: get_kit_manifest
tools.description: Get the kit.json v0.1 manifest for one listing: how to call it (HTTP, MCP or A2A endpoints), input/output schema references, payment offers (rail, network, asset, payTo, amount), discovery files and a trust summary. Use it when you are about to call a listing yourself; use get_kit for human-readable

tools.name: call_kit
tools.description: Send a request to a listing's x402 endpoint through Agentropolis and get the seller's raw response back (status, headers, body). Use it only for listings whose search result has buy='relay_x402' (links.call present); for any other listing, call the seller directly using get_kit_manifest. Flow: call

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every category in the Agentropolis index with its listing count, largest first (about 18 snake_case ids such as web_search, crypto_onchain_data, llm_inference). Use it to pick a valid value for search_kits' category filter or to see what the index covers; for paid-usage numbers per category use

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the registries and directories Agentropolis ingests or deliberately excludes, with each source's license or terms decision, robots handling and listing count (e.g. Official MCP Registry CC0, x402-list.com CC BY 4.0; Coinbase Bazaar link-out only). Use it to check provenance or the attribution r

tools.name: get_trust_method
tools.description: Explain how Agentropolis computes trust scores (method hub-trust-v0.1) and ranks search results: which payment evidence counts, wash-trading exclusions, low-sample caps, why our own test purchases never count, and what a null score means. Use it to interpret the trust and badge fields from search_ki

tools.name: get_bazaar_link
tools.description: Build a URL that searches Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (Agentic.Market) for a query. Use it when you want x402 services that may be missing from the Agentropolis index; it only returns a link for you or your user to open. Agentropolis makes no request to Coinbase and does not cache or republish Bazaar dat

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Get 30-day x402 paid-usage statistics per category, with wash trading filtered out: services with paid usage, verified buyers, settlements, median listed price and listings excluded for wash signals. Use it for market sizing or price benchmarking; to find individual tools use search_kits. Read-only,

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: List Agentropolis platform features with status (live, partial, stub, planned), endpoint and guardrails: badges, the x402 relay, seller claims and analytics, sponsored placement, market data, billing. Use it to check whether a platform capability exists before relying on it; it describes Agentropoli

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_kits" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call_kit, get_bazaar_link · Private data: get_kit, get_kit_manifest, call_kit, get_market_snapshot · Public sink: call_kit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: call_kit, get_bazaar_link · Private data: get_kit, get_kit_manifest, call_kit, get_market_snapshot · Public sink: call_kit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_kits" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Use it first when you need a tool for a task; then use get_kit for one listing's trust evidence and price, or get_kit_manifest fo"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
